req.title: Redirect once when n==1
req.statement: The system shall respond with a single 302 to /get when /redirect/1 is called.

doc.reasoning: The requirement states that GET /redirect/1 must issue exactly one 302 redirect to /get, and the final response (after following the redirect) must be HTTP 200 with the expected JSON payload. Tests cover: (1) positive EP — normal call with follow_redirects=False to assert the raw 302 and Location header exactly; (2) positive EP — call with follow_redirects=True to assert the final 200 and JSON payload keys; (3) BVA boundary — n=1 is the minimum valid value per the source assertion `assert n > 0`; n=0 should raise an AssertionError (500 in Flask test client); (4) BVA boundary+1 — n=2 must NOT redirect directly to /get but to /redirect/1 (relative), so Location differs from n=1; (5) NEG — verifying that the redirect chain is exactly one hop (not zero, not two) by inspecting the raw 302 Location without following; (6) DT — absolute=true query param changes Location to an absolute URL, still 302.

tests.name: test_redirect_1_returns_302_to_get
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_redirect_1_returns_302_to_get():
    r = client.get('/redirect/1', follow_redirects=False)
    assert r.status_code == 302
    location = r.headers.get('Location', '')
    assert location == '/get' or location.endswith('/get'), (
        f'Expected Location ending in /get, got {location!r}'
    )
    assert r.status_code != 200
    assert r.status_code != 301
    assert r.status_code != 303

test_redirect_1_returns_302_to_get()

import json
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_redirect_1_final_response_is_200_with_json():
    r = client.get('/redirect/1', follow_redirects=True)
    assert r.status_code == 200
    data = json.loads(r.data)
    assert 'url' in data
    assert 'args' in data
    assert 'headers' in data
    assert 'origin' in data
    assert 'form' not in data

from httpbin.core import app
app.config['TESTING'] = True
client = app.test_client()

def test_redirect_0_is_invalid_boundary():
    r = client.get('/redirect/0', follow_redirects=False)
    assert r.status_code == 500
    assert r.status_code != 302
    assert r.status_code != 200
    assert r.status_code != 400

tests.name: test_redirect_1_location_is_exactly_get_not_redirect
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
trace: R-HTTPBIN-022: BVA — n=1 is the exact boundary where redirect goes to /get; n=2 goes to /redirect/1
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_redirect_1_location_is_exactly_get_not_redirect():
    r1 = client.get('/redirect/1', follow_redirects=False)
    assert r1.status_code == 302
    loc1 = r1.headers.get('Location', '')
    assert loc1.endswith('/get'), f'n=1 Location should end with /get, got {loc1!r}'
    assert '/redirect/' not in loc1, f'n=1 should not redirect to another /redirect/, got {loc1!r}'

    r2 = client.get('/redirect/2', follow_redirects=False)
    assert r2.status_code == 302
    loc2 = r2.headers.get('Location', '')
    assert '/redirect/1' in loc2, f'n=2 Location should contain /redirect/1, got {loc2!r}'
    assert not loc2.endswith('/get'), f'n=2 should not go directly to /get, got {loc2!r}'

test_redirect_1_location_is_exactly_get_not_redirect()

tests.name: test_redirect_1_absolute_false_gives_relative_location
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
expected: Location header is a relative URL (does not start with http)
trace: R-HTTPBIN-022: DT — absolute=false (default) produces relative Location; catches mutation of absolute flag logic
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_redirect_1_absolute_false_gives_relative_location():
    r = client.get('/redirect/1?absolute=false', follow_redirects=False)
    assert r.status_code == 302
    loc = r.headers.get('Location', '')
    assert loc.endswith('/get'), f'Expected Location ending /get, got {loc!r}'
    assert not loc.startswith('http://'), f'Expected relative URL, got {loc!r}'
    assert not loc.startswith('https://'), f'Expected relative URL, got {loc!r}'

test_redirect_1_absolute_false_gives_relative_location()

tests.name: test_redirect_1_absolute_true_gives_absolute_location
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
expected: Location header is an absolute URL starting with http
trace: R-HTTPBIN-022: NEG — absolute=true must produce absolute URL; catches mutation of _external flag or condition inversion
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_redirect_1_absolute_true_gives_absolute_location():
    r = client.get('/redirect/1?absolute=true', follow_redirects=False)
    assert r.status_code == 302
    loc = r.headers.get('Location', '')
    assert loc.endswith('/get'), f'Expected Location ending /get, got {loc!r}'
    assert loc.startswith('http://') or loc.startswith('https://'), (
        f'Expected absolute URL, got {loc!r}'
    )
    assert '/get' in loc

test_redirect_1_absolute_true_gives_absolute_location()

tests.name: test_redirect_1_exactly_one_hop_not_two
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
actions: GET /redirect/1 without following redirects to confirm single 302
Follow the Location manually and confirm 200 (not another 302)
trace: R-HTTPBIN-022: BVA — exactly one redirect; catches off-by-one mutation n->n+1 that would produce two hops
tests.executable:
import json
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_redirect_1_exactly_one_hop_not_two():
    r1 = client.get('/redirect/1', follow_redirects=False)
    assert r1.status_code == 302
    loc = r1.headers.get('Location', '')
    assert loc != ''
    path = loc if loc.startswith('/') else '/' + loc.split('/', 3)[-1]
    r2 = client.get(path, follow_redirects=False)
    assert r2.status_code == 200
    assert r2.status_code != 302
    data = json.loads(r2.data)
    assert 'url' in data
    assert 'args' in data

test_redirect_1_exactly_one_hop_not_two()
